description: Redesign CreateScreen.tsx to match premium artwork upload UI with publish header, status banner, large hero preview with carousel navigation, thumbnail strip with drag-to-reorder, improved form fields, compliance section cards, and floating upload progress indicator. All existing business logic (media picker, FormData construction, API upload, Redux dispatches, validation) must be preserved exactly as-is.
steps: Rewrite mobile/src/screens/create/CreateScreen.tsx with the following visual structure while keeping ALL existing state, hooks, effects, and handler functions unchanged:

1. PUBLISH HEADER: Top navigation bar with back button (Feather 'arrow-left'), centered title 'Upload Artwork', and Publish button as red rounded pill (backgroundColor #FF3B30, borderRadius 20, paddingHorizontal 20). Publish button shows disabled/enabled/uploading states visually.

2. PUBLISH STATUS BANNER: Green status card below header showing dynamic validation state. When media selected: green background (#F0FFF4), 'Ready to publish' with checkmark, 'X items uploaded'. When no media: amber (#FFFBEB), 'Minimum 1 artwork required'. Include media counter badge on right: 'Media N/6'.

3. LARGE HERO PREVIEW: Large rounded (borderRadius 16) media preview container (aspectRatio 4/5). Show active media item. For videos: show video badge with duration and play icon overlay. Add 'Cover' badge (red pill) on the first/cover item. Add position indicator '2/5' bottom-right.

4. CAROUSEL NAVIGATION: Previous/Next large circular arrow buttons (white background, shadow, Feather 'chevron-left'/'chevron-right') overlaid on left/right of hero preview. Update activePreviewIndex on press.
5. PAGINATION DOTS: Below hero preview, dots for each media item. Active dot is red (#FF3B30), inactive is grey.

6. THUMBNAIL STRIP: Horizontal ScrollView of thumbnails (width 68, height 68, borderRadius 10). Active thumbnail has red border. Each thumbnail has: delete button (top-right X), video duration badge (bottom-left), selection border when active. Add 'Add Media' card at end with dashed border and + icon.
7. UPLOAD LIMITS TEXT: Display formatted limits below thumbnails: 'Up to 5 images + 1 video | JPG, PNG, WEBP, MP4 | Max 10MB/image, 50MB/video'.

8. DESCRIPTION FIELD: Large rounded textarea (borderRadius 14, backgroundColor lightColors.surface, borderWidth 1, borderColor lightColors.border). Character counter showing current/2000. Placeholder 'Describe your artwork...'.
9. KEYWORDS/TAGS FIELD: Rounded input (borderRadius 14) with improved helper text 'Separate with commas (e.g., landscape, oil painting, Nepal)'.
10. ARTWORK TYPES: Current chip logic preserved. Red selected chips (#FF3B30 background, white text), grey unselected (lightColors.surface background, border). Wrap in horizontal ScrollView.

11. COMPLIANCE SECTION: Card layout (rounded, bordered, lightColors.surface background) containing all three checkboxes grouped together. Improved wording: 'I confirm this artwork is NOT AI-generated' for original declaration with info icon. 'This artwork was created with AI tools' for AI disclosure. '18+ / Mature Content' for NSFW. Each with Ionicons checkbox icons.

12. UPLOAD PROGRESS (floating): When isPublishing is true, show a bottom floating card (position absolute, bottom 20, full width minus padding) with: cloud upload icon, progress bar (red fill), percentage text, 'Uploading artwork...' text. Use Animated API for slide-up entrance.

13. PUBLISH BUTTON STATES: Visually indicate states - Ready (red, enabled), Missing fields (grey, disabled with hint), Uploading (show progress), Completed (green flash). Without changing validation logic.
14. ANIMATIONS: Fade-in for sections on mount using Animated API. Scale press effect on publish button. Smooth opacity transition for status banner color changes. Slide-up for upload progress card.
15. GUEST MODE: Preserve existing guest info card and guest warning card with improved styling (rounded, proper shadows).

16. Preserve ALL existing logic exactly: pickImage (with selectionLimit: Math.max(1, 6 - mediaItems.length)), removeMediaItem, toggleArtworkType, resetForm, handlePublish (with FormData construction loop, api.post, prependFeedPost, prependMyPost dispatches), all validation logic, all error handling.
17. Use lightColors from theme/colors.ts consistently. Ensure responsive layout across devices.
acceptance_criteria: CreateScreen renders without errors with all existing imports resolving correctly
Media picker (pickImage) preserves exact same logic: ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync with selectionLimit: Math.max(1, 6 - mediaItems.length), allowsMultipleSelection: true, quality: 0.8
FormData construction in handlePublish appends ALL mediaItems in a loop - no media is lost
api.post('/posts', formData, { headers multipart, timeout 120000, onUploadProgress }) call is preserved exactly
prependFeedPost and prependMyPost Redux dispatches after successful publish are preserved
All file size validations (10MB images, 50MB videos, 100MB total) are preserved
artworkType chips from /config/artwork-types API fetch are preserved
isAIGenerated, isOriginalContent, isNsfw checkboxes and their FormData append logic are preserved
Guest mode restriction in pickImage and handlePublish is preserved
Visual output matches premium upload UI design with proper spacing, rounded components, and status indicators
verification: Read the final CreateScreen.tsx and verify handlePublish function has identical FormData construction logic
Verify pickImage function preserves selectionLimit: Math.max(1, 6 - mediaItems.length) and all file size checks
Verify all imports resolve to existing modules
Verify the component exports as named export { CreateScreen }
Verify MAX_IMAGES = 5 and MAX_VIDEOS = 1 constants are present
Verify no media items are filtered out or lost between selection and FormData append
findings: All business logic preserved exactly - pickImage with selectionLimit: Math.max(1, 6 - mediaItems.length), handlePublish with FormData loop over all mediaItems, api.post with multipart headers and 120000 timeout, prependFeedPost/prependMyPost dispatches, all file size validations (10MB images, 50MB videos, 100MB total), guest mode restrictions. No new npm dependencies. Used React Native built-in Animated API for fade-in, scale press, and slide-up progress. Cannot run build/test since network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - validation done via code review and structural verification (407 balanced braces). Media pipeline is completely unchanged per orchestrator guidance.
